summary: Built 1917, rebuilt 1953, burned in the 2020 Slater Fire, and rebuilt again in 2024 by the Siskiyou Mountain Club; now rented via Recreation.gov.

facts.design: L-4, 14x14 ft hip-roof cab on a 15 ft wood tower (1953); legs later removed and cab set on a low stone base, catwalk later widened with a deck; rebuilt 2024 after the 2020 Slater Fire

access.note: Rented through Recreation.gov during the snow-free season, up to 3 consecutive nights, up to 4 guests.

visit.trail_note: 30 to 40 steep, uneven steps lead up to the cabin.

evidence.supports: burned in the 2020 Slater Fire, rebuilt 2024 by Siskiyou Mountain Club and USFS
evidence.quote: In 2024, the Siskiyou Mountain Club partnered with the US Forest Service to rebuild the Bolan Mountain Lookout after it burned down in the Slater fire in 2020.

evidence.supports: glass on all sides, mountain views
evidence.quote: Bolan Mountain Lookout is surrounded by glass windows on all sides, providing visitors with an unparalleled view of the sheer drop-offs sharp cliffs, and breath-taking views of the rugged Siskiyou Mountains.
The historic lookout is available for rent during the snow-free season with a maximum length of stay being 3 consecutive nights, and guests must bring several of their own amenities.
The 14 x 14 foot one room cabin is designed to house a maximum of four people, and offers a primitive camping experience.
The 30 to 40 steps up to the lookout are steep and uneven, so visitors should use caution when climbing to the main cabin.

evidence.supports: table, two chairs, bed folds into two twins
evidence.quote: The room is equipped with a table, two chairs, a single bed with pad that folds out into two twins, cleaning supplies and a fire extinguisher.
No water is available on site, so guests must pack in water for drinking, cooking and washing.
A vault toilet is located near the lookout.

evidence.supports: views of Red Buttes, Siskiyou Wilderness, Preston Peak, Bolan Lake, Mount Shasta
evidence.quote: From the lookout, guests are treated to expansive views of the Red Buttes and Siskiyou Wilderness areas, Preston Peak and Bolan Lake.

evidence.supports: Mount Shasta visible on clear day
evidence.quote: On a clear day, even Mount Shasta is visible to the southeast.

evidence.supports: Bolan Lake stocked with trout, non-motorized boating
evidence.quote: Hikers may enjoy spending a day hiking the Bolan Lake Trail down to Bolan Lake. Hemmed in by conifer forest, the lake is stocked with trout, and is an ideal setting to enjoy fishing, non-motorized boating such as kayaking or picnicking at its banks.
A dip in the cool waters provides much needed relief from a hot summer day.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com lists the lookout as 'R.I.P. 1953-2020', reflecting its status after it burned in the 2020 Slater Fire; it was rebuilt in 2024 by the Siskiyou Mountain Club and the U.S. Forest Service and is standing and rented again.

notes_for_editor: NHLR's 'legs later removed... low stone base' and 'recently restored... catwalk' changes carry no specific dates. The Slater Fire's exact burn date isn't pinned down beyond 'September 2020'.
